description: Every Deutero endpoint, plus the flow-behaviour and fielding answers that take many API calls to assemble and that no single endpoint returns.

novel_features.name: Flow behavior coverage
novel_features.description: Shows how an Interview Flow actually routed across a whole study: every branch arm's share, how often the otherwise path fired, classifier errors, which steps interviews reached, and which declared variables are being captured. Flow-mode studies only: a linear study has no branch or flow records and correctly returns nothing.

novel_features.name: Payout reconciliation
novel_features.description: Finds participants who completed a study but were never successfully notified, by joining completed interviews against the webhook deliveries that were supposed to tell your system about them.

novel_features.name: Study definition diff
novel_features.description: Compares two complete study definitions field by field — details, welcome and translations, screening, characteristics, questions or flow, recruitment — or compares a live study against a saved bundle file.

novel_features.name: Answer rectangle
novel_features.description: Turns a study into a real table: one row per interview, one column per question or captured variable, with the external participant id as the join key and optional participant characteristic columns via --with-characteristics. Works for both linear and flow studies.

novel_features.name: Flow effects audit
novel_features.description: Aggregates what a flow's side steps actually did across a study: failed data fetches with status codes, undelivered signals, and dry-run signals from simulations kept separate from real ones. Flow-mode studies only: a linear study has no branch or flow records and correctly returns nothing.

novel_features.name: Study bundle export and apply
novel_features.description: Snapshots an entire study definition — details, welcome and translations, screening, characteristics, questions or flow, recruitment — into one file. The write half is a separate command, 'study apply --file <f>', which plans by default and writes only with --confirm, and which replays whole-resource sections only (question lists replay via 'studies questions').

novel_features.name: Rehearsal vs reality diff
novel_features.description: Compares the simulated persona cohort against real participants on the same measures: step reach, branch arm mix, variable capture rate, message count and duration. Needs both cohorts; branch and variable measures are flow-mode only.

novel_features.name: Fielding burn rate
novel_features.description: Completions per day against the response quota, projecting the date the quota fills.

novel_features.name: Cross-tab
novel_features.description: Segments any scale or options question by any participant characteristic, with per-cell counts and per-segment completion rate.

novel_features.name: Saturation curve
novel_features.description: Counts how many genuinely new terms each successive interview contributes, and marks the point where the curve flattens. A mechanical word-level proxy for new content, not a judgement about meaning.
